marketLayer.title: HK Tech & Enterprise Cloud
marketLayer.fact: The Hang Seng Tech Index rose 1.8% today, led by strong Southbound capital inflows into major internet and cloud giants following accelerated domestic AI commercialization reports.
marketLayer.inference: Institutional investors are re-rating Chinese tech majors as monetization pathways for enterprise AI solutions become increasingly tangible.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Sustained geopolitical friction regarding foreign technology access and advanced hardware import constraints.

marketLayer.title: US Mega-Cap Semiconductor & AI Infrastructure
marketLayer.fact: US semiconductor shares rallied overnight after leading cloud service providers reaffirmed elevated capital expenditure commitments for next-generation data center expansions.
marketLayer.inference: Robust downstream capex maintains high earnings visibility across the AI hardware supply chain, providing cross-market support to Asian tech export suppliers.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Macroeconomic risks around the Federal Reserve rate path and potential margin compression if infrastructure spending outpaces near-term software revenues.

marketLayer.title: HK New Energy Vehicles (NEV)
marketLayer.fact: Leading Chinese NEV makers posted strong mid-month delivery estimates supported by expanded city-level consumer trade-in subsidies.
marketLayer.inference: Domestic delivery volume strength is expected to buffer revenue against persistent price competition in the lower-to-mid market segments.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Evolving international trade barriers and prospective tariff adjustments targeting foreign automotive exports.
